description: This file is a CMake script that defines functions for creating and registering new event objects within a software project. It includes functions to generate event objects, assign properties, and define global helper functions for event emission and handling. It also provides an alternative implementation optimized for speed, bypassing certain common features.

methods.name: event_new
methods.description: Creates a new event object with a specified event ID or generates a unique ID if none is provided. Registers the event globally and defines related helper functions for emitters and handlers. Supports two implementations: a standard version using 'curry3' and 'map_set', and a faster version that manually defines functions with 'function_new' and 'eval'.
